{{Quote|We've learned that Dooku has hired the Zeltron bounty hunter, Vianna D'Pow, to carry out the mission. Stay sharp, Obi-Wan. I've been on the other end of her blaster more times than I like to remember.|Mace Windu, relaying information to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="cwa" />}}
Around the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was sent on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to stop a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] plan that involved taking the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] template. Unbeknownst to Kenobi, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] hired the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Vianna D'Pow]] to carry out the plan, and the bounty hunter had arrived on Kamino before Kenobi. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] told Kenobi of whom Dooku hired for the plan via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], D'Pow revealed herself to Kenobi. D'Pow, who had the DNA template in her possession, [[Death/Legends|killed]] two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who stood near Kenobi before departing. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] raced after D'Pow, who was trying to escape. After a confrontation between the two, the bounty hunter fled aboard her [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]], but she lost possession of the DNA template while fighting Kenobi, who recovered it.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|She met with me to place an order for one solitary clone&hellip; a clone of herself.|Lama Su, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="cwa" />}}
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="cwamain" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] created a plan to steal the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] template, an item that was being used to create the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. To carry out the plan, Dooku hired the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Vianna D'Pow]]. After landing on Kamino, D'Pow found the DNA template vial in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] and took the item without attracting attention. D'Pow also met with Kamino's [[Prime Minister (Kamino)|Prime Minister]], [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]],<ref name="cwa" /> and requested a clone of herself because she felt lonely.<ref name="cswe">{{CSWECite|I||D'Pow, Vianna}}</ref> Su, who did not realize that D'Pow stole Fett's DNA template, authorized the order.<ref name="cwa" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|It is good to see you again, Master Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi. I trust the clone armies are satisfactory thus far?''"<br />"''They play their part well, thank you. And it is the clones, or rather, ''the original host'' that brings me here.''"<br />"''The bounty hunter, Jango Fett.''"<br />"''More specifically, his ''genetic material''.|Lama Su, greeting Kenobi, after the latter arrived on Kamino|<ref name="cwa" />}}
[[File:KenobivsDPow-CWA8.jpg|thumb|left|260px|D'Pow attacking Kenobi]]
After the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] learned about the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] plan to steal Fett's DNA template, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was dispatched to Kamino alongside a group of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. After Kenobi landed on Kamino, Su greeted the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], eager to know if the Republic's Grand Army had been satisfactory since their deployment. Kenobi, however, began to reveal the Jedi's knowledge of the Confederate plan to the Prime Minister. Shortly thereafter, Kenobi answered a [[holograph]]ic transmission from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], who revealed that Dooku had hired D'Pow to carry out the plan of stealing Fett's DNA template.<ref name="cwa" />

[[File:Vianna_vs_ObiWan.png|thumb|right|260px|Kenobi and D'Pow fighting in the ocean]]
As Kenobi and Windu conferred, D'Pow revealed herself from a nearby hallway and attacked two clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] who stood near Kenobi. After [[Death/Legends|killing]] the two [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], D'Pow took out the DNA template vial and showed Kenobi before running outside the building. Su tried to stop Kenobi from chasing D'Pow, although to no avail. Outside, the Zeltron jumped onto a flying [[Aiwha/Legends|Aiwha]] to escape from the pursuing Kenobi, although the Jedi Knight, likewise, leapt onto the same creature. As Kenobi utilized his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to stop her, D'Pow took out her [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and [[shock whip]], and a fight between the two broke out. When the Aiwha dived into the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]], Kenobi and D'Pow lost their weaponry and began to engage each other in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]].<ref name="cwa" />

D'Pow, however, escaped after she pressed a button on her [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], which activated her [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]]. Though she fled aboard her speeder, the Jedi Knight had recovered the stolen DNA template during their fight in the water and displayed the vial to the departing D'Pow. Kenobi returned to Su, who was inside the building. When the Prime Minister told the Jedi Knight that he tried to stop him from chasing D'Pow, Kenobi questioned his actions. Su revealed that D'Pow had met with him because she wanted a clone of herself. He was not sure if he should cancel the order, but Kenobi wanted Su to fulfill the order for D'Pow,<ref name="cwa" /> since it would help ease her feelings of loneliness.<ref name="cswe" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Remember assassin, you're to recover the clone DNA.''"<br />"''Why not just destroy it?''"<br />"''Because the DNA could unlock new possibilities for us.|General Grievous and Asajj Ventress, during their assault on Kamino|<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>}}
{{Main|Battle of Kamino/Legends}}
[[File:SkywalkerKenobi-ARCT.png|thumb|left|300px|In 21 BBY, Obi-Wan Kenobi would find himself back on Kamino and realized the Separatists were once more after Jango Fett's DNA.]]
In [[21 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 62: Kamino">{{FactFile2014|62|21 BBY 17-18|Defence of Kamino}}</ref> the Confederacy would launch another effort to recover Fett's DNA from Kamino. However, the effort occurred as part of a full-scale assault, beginning the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]]. Carried out by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]],<ref name="ARC Troopers" /> themselves the architects of a [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|previously-aborted]] Kamino invasion plan<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref> from 22 BBY,<ref name="Rookies Date">{{TCWdates|105}}</ref> the invasion saw [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] march through Tipoca City while Ventress attempted to recover the DNA, yet their efforts would fail thanks to the efforts of the clone troopers, who rallied to defend their home, and Jedi Generals Kenobi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]. Kenobi himself was the one to deduce that the Separatists were after Fett's DNA when he realized there were too few [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to conquer Tipoca City.<ref name="ARC Troopers" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to Kamino first appeared in "[[One of a Kind (comic story)|One of a Kind]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] that was published in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 8|eighth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] comic series. ''One of a Kind'', and the eighth volume, were published in [[October]] [[2007]].<ref name="cwa" />
